name: Fisher's Talent
oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal it if it's a land card. Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token if you revealed it this way. Then draw a card.
{G}{U}: Level 2
If you would create a Fish token, create a 3/3 blue Shark creature token instead.
{2}{G}{U}: Level 3
If you would create a Shark token, create an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token instead.
blocked_sentences: If you would create a Fish token, create a 3/3 blue Shark creature token instead.

needs.what: a 3/3 blue Shark creature token (no abilities), e.g. id shark_3_3_u, for the level-2 replace_token_creation create_instead (Fish -> Shark); the level-3 line then replaces that Shark with the existing octopus_8_8_u
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids holds fish_1_1_u and octopus_8_8_u but the only Shark is shark_x_x_u_flying, a 0/0 Shark with flying, which is not a 3/3 vanilla Shark; substituting it would make the wrong token
